patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: origin (Krishna-Mahabaleshwar), largest tributary (Pranhita / Tungabhadra), second largest basin (Godavari), which river is NOT west-flowing.
AP tilt: Krishna's course (Mahabaleshwar-Sangli-Hamsaladeevi), Tungabhadra as Krishna tributary, Jayamangala-Pennar, NSTR on Krishna, Gokak falls-Ghataprabha.
Other-PSC staples: west-flowing rivers have estuaries not deltas, rift-valley Narmada/Tapi, Amarkantak sources, waterfall-river pairs, lake-state pairs.
App leans on long multi-statement and 4-pair match items and current-affairs (ILR, IWT); the exam mostly uses single-fact or short pair questions.
Trap facts: Tapi lies between Satpura and Ajanta (not Vindhya); Pranhita = Wardha + Wainganga; Kosi is left-bank; Hagari = Vedavathi joins Tungabhadra.
